title: A supported Koszul detector relative to an open
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with derived module categories and exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-category]. Let T be closed with quasi-compact complement, and let X=U union V with U quasi-compact open and V affine open. There is a perfect quasi-coherent A [def-pc-perfect-complex], with every cohomology stalk outside T zero, whose derived restriction to U is zero. For every quasi-coherent C supported on T whose restriction to U is zero, vanishing of Hom(A[n],C) for all integers n implies C is zero. No arbitrary perfect summand and no right adjoint is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 0A9A: affine detection and supported Koszul construction on the affine complement

proof.text: Set S=T intersect (X minus U). It is closed and contained in V by the cover. For the inverse image S' on Y=V.toScheme, the image of its complement is (T-complement intersect V) union (U intersect V). Both intersections are compact by quasi-separatedness and the given compactness hypotheses, so S' has compact complement in Y. Transport the chosen derived localization on the over-site of V through Modules.overEquiv: the standard derived category on Y is w-locally-small by its faithful derived equivalence with the chosen over-site category, and hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall gives the required localization. Then lem-pc-derived-open-localization-universe supplies localizations on every open of Y. Y is affine, compact and quasi-separated.

source.place: Lemma 36.15.4, affine detection and supported Koszul construction in the induction step; transport and stalk computations written out in Lean

proof.text: Use the singleton affine cover {top} of Y and lem-pc-supported-perfect-detector-affine with S' to obtain B perfect, quasi-coherent and detecting S'-supported objects. Apply lem-pc-supported-open-extension to B and the globally closed S contained in V. This gives A perfect, quasi-coherent, supported on S, and Hom(A[n],C) equivalent to Hom(B[n],C|V). Since S is contained in T, A is supported on T; since U is disjoint from S, lem-pc-supported-derived-restriction-zero makes A|U zero.

source.place: Lemma 36.15.4, affine detection and supported Koszul construction in the induction step; transport and stalk computations written out in Lean

proof.text: Given C as in the theorem, lem-pc-derived-open-restriction-qcoh-iff and isQuasicoherent_over make C|V quasi-coherent. Exactness gives H^n(C|V)=H^n(C)|V and restrictStalkNatIso identifies its stalk with the original stalk. Off T it is zero by hypothesis. At a point of T outside S', the point belongs to U; homology of the zero restriction C|U is zero, and the same stalk comparison makes the original stalk zero. Thus C|V is supported on S'. The Hom equivalence of the extension transfers every orthogonality hypothesis to B, and the affine detector makes C|V zero.

proof.text: The derived over equivalence is faithful, so the vanishing on the scheme V implies vanishing in its localized over-site category. Apply lem-pc-derived-restriction-isIso-open-cover to the zero endomorphism of C. Its restrictions to U and V are maps between zero objects, hence invertible. Therefore the zero endomorphism of C is invertible; its inverse identity implies id_C=0, which is exactly IsZero C. Empty opens, empty T, and total U are included throughout; no nonemptiness assumption is introduced.

theorem exists_supported_koszul_relative_detector
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    (U : X.Opens) (V : X.affineOpens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (hcover : U ⊔ (V : X.Opens) = ⊤) :
    ∃ A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Scheme.IsPerfect X A.obj ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj A.obj).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj A.obj) ∧
      ∀ C : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj C.obj).val.presheaf x))) →
        IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (A.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ C.obj)) → IsZero C.obj
